facts.text: The Stratford Festival's 2024 season draws attendance of 430,000, plus 19,500 at Forum events.
facts.evidence: The 2024 season attracted attendance of 430,000 people, with an additional 19,500 attending Forum events. A further 46,000 streamed productions on Stratfest@Home.

facts.text: Aisin Canada, which makes sunroofs, door frames and seating components in Stratford, is expanding its plant with 135,000 square feet of new manufacturing and office space.
facts.evidence: The planned expansion includes 135,000 square feet of new manufacturing and office space. ... The company manufactures sunroofs, doorframes, power back doors, moldings, and seating components.

facts.text: A $2.2 million provincial investment in Aisin Canada creates 30 new jobs and protects 530 positions in Stratford.
facts.publisher: Office of Matthew Rae, MPP for Perth-Wellington
facts.evidence: the investment will create 30 new, good-paying jobs and protect 530 positions in Stratford.

facts.text: Schaeffler Canada designs and manufactures rolling bearings for cars in Stratford, where a $13.1 million expansion added two assembly lines and 44 jobs.
facts.evidence: Schaeffler Canada designs and manufactures rolling bearings and related systems for cars. The company planned a $13.1 million expansion project ... adding two new assembly lines and creating 44 new jobs.

meta.descriptor: a small city on the Avon River in southwestern Ontario
meta.fact: home to the Stratford Festival, which drew 430,000 attendees in 2024, and a large auto-parts base

overview: Stratford had 33,232 residents in 2021, up 5.6 per cent from 2016, in 14,743 occupied homes packed into just 30 square kilometres. That density means most customers are a short drive from any downtown storefront.

The city runs on two engines: the Stratford Festival, which brings hundreds of thousands of theatre visitors each season, and auto-parts plants such as Aisin and Schaeffler. Businesses compete for steady local households and a large seasonal visitor market, and need to be found by both.

byService.lead-generation: Lead generation in Stratford should run on two calendars, reaching the 14,743 local households year round and ramping up campaigns aimed at theatre visitors during the Festival season.
byService.seo: Visitors plan Stratford trips weeks ahead, so SEO should target searches pairing the city with the Festival, dining and lodging, while separate pages capture year-round local service searches.
byService.website-development: Because many Stratford customers arrive from out of town for a performance, a website there needs clear booking, hours, parking details and maps that work well on a phone.
byService.branding: In a compact city of about 33,000 people that trades on arts and heritage, branding should feel considered and local, signalling quality to both theatre visitors and long-time residents.
